name: ireland-compliance-2026
display_name: Ireland Compliance 2026 — IAF/SEAR, CBI Consumer Protection Code 2026, AML, Companies Act
description: Structured knowledge graph for the Irish regulatory wave of 2024-2026: the Individual Accountability Framework Act 2023 + SEAR (Senior Executive Accountability Regime — first wave applied 1 Jul 2024, (I)NED scope expansion live 1 Jul 2025), the CBI Consumer Protection Code 2026 (in force 24 March 2026), the Irish AML framework (CJMLA 2010-2021 awaiting EU AMLR transposition), Companies Act 2014 director duties (ss.223-225) and the related Fitness & Probity Regime. Plus DPA 2018/UK GDPR-divergent DPC enforcement, the Irish MiCA SI 268/2024, CSRD transposition SI 336/2024, CBI UCITS/AIFMD funds rules, and the Criminal Justice (Corruption Offences) Act 2018.
author: Futurechain FCP Team
